command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state >/dev/null; echo '=== package ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path --user 0 moe.shizuku.privileged.api; echo '=== app pid before ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof moe.shizuku.privileged.api || true; echo '=== start script ==='; SCRIPT=''; for p in /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh; do if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell test -f "$p"; then SCRIPT=$p; echo start_script=$p; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$SCRIPT" ]; then echo start_script_missing=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell find /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 40 || true; exit 21; fi; echo '=== starting ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell sh "$SCRIPT"; sleep 3; echo '=== processes ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -Ei 'shizuku|rikka' || true; echo '=== binder service hints ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity services 2>/dev/null | grep -i -A3 -B2 shizuku | head -n 80 || true; echo phase2c_shizuku_server_start_complete=true
